name: walnut

Bespoke luxury yacht millwork, deep warm chocolate and cognac heartwood, fine elegant straight quarter-sawn vertical grain with occasional beautiful restrained cathedral figure, rich natural color variation and extremely fine pores. New immaculate satin oiled timber, expensive refined joinery material, never rustic, never old, no scratches, no weathering, no grime. Surface texture fills every pixel edge to edge. NO plank seams, NO room, NO furniture, NO perspective, NO bevels, NO lighting or specular highlights baked in, NO shadows, NO vignette, NO text or labels. Crisp realistic high fidelity photographed wood material under flat cross-polarized light, tiling seamlessly in both directions.

name: cosmos
prompt: Wide seamless 2:1 equirectangular SPACE ENVIRONMENT TEXTURE for immersive game background. Breathtaking elegant deep-space astrophotography, ink black open space across the middle 60 percent, hundreds of tiny crisp silver stars at distinct intensities and sizes, delicate distant dusty violet and cobalt nebula wisps along the far left and upper edge, fine pearl starlight, a few restrained four point diffraction spikes. No planet filling the image, no sun, no landscape, no room, no text, no logo, no fake neon, no lensflare circles, no huge soft blobs. Horizontal edges match seamlessly for a 360 degree sky. The center stays mostly black so white smoke is legible.

Rich sophisticated cinematic natural light, exquisite real material texture. Not a blank beige rectangle, not dirty, not grime.
